rows.reason: confidence is diagnostic and never accepts rows
budgets are frozen before cost-error aggregation
triggers exclude joint_exact and exact labels
row count and row hash gate readiness
model-family cells are emitted before summary
CCG certificate artifact hash and checks gate readiness
raw output and source hashes are checked
future partition is recorded and not used for routing

field_principles.aggregate_recomputation_receipts: States the formulas and row hashes used for aggregate recomputation.
field_principles.arm:always_refine: The control spends exact checker work on every row.
field_principles.arm:never_refine: The baseline spends no extra checker calls and exposes budgeted misses.
field_principles.arm:selective_refine: The selective arm spends work only under allowed exact triggers.
field_principles.attack_matrix: Proves known authority, budget, row, source, certificate, and leakage attacks fail closed.
field_principles.budget:checker_calls: Checker-call limits are frozen before cost-error aggregation.
field_principles.budget:wall_time: Wall-time limits are frozen before cost-error aggregation.
field_principles.confidence_authority_count: Must stay zero because confidence is diagnostic only.
field_principles.corpus_row_checker_certificate_and_parti: Binds rows, raw outputs, checkers, certificates, and partitions.
field_principles.cost_error: Cost errors measure missed exact-incorrect rows within budget.
field_principles.effective_sample_sizes_and_uncertainty: Reports sample size and uncertainty for each stratum.
field_principles.exp6427_gate_receipts: Pins the clean row gate and the Exp6416 exact-refinement reference gate.
field_principles.false_accept_and_false_reject_deltas: Shows whether selective changes release harm against controls.
field_principles.field_principles: Documents why each required field exists.
field_principles.field_provenance: States how each required field was produced.
field_principles.gate:exp6416: Exp6416 supplies a frozen exact-refinement reference, not new outcomes.
field_principles.gate:exp6427: Exp6427 is the immutable row gate, not a mutable data source.
field_principles.harm_underpowered_missing_and_flagged_ce: Names underpowered or missing cells instead of pooling them away.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Gives a terminal-prefix verdict with the exact authority boundary.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares deterministic replay over frozen rows with no new LLM call.
field_principles.interaction_penalty: Measures interacting minus independent outcomes at each constraint count.
field_principles.joint_success: Reports exact joint success from rows.
field_principles.joint_success_decay_by_constraint_count: Shows joint collapse as simultaneous constraints accumulate.
field_principles.per_arm_constraint_count_interaction_mod: Reports matched arm metrics by required strata.
field_principles.per_constraint_success: Reports exact per-constraint success from rows.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Provides the row and arm decisions behind every comparative claim.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Lists local gates checked before accepting the artifact.
field_principles.preregistered_arm_and_budget_contract: Freezes arms and budgets before cost-error aggregation.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Shows conductor, ops, traceability, and upstream artifacts stayed byte-stable.
field_principles.random_seed: Pins deterministic row order, trigger mapping, and budget replay.
field_principles.readiness:verification_cost_study_ready_: Readiness requires frozen budgets, complete rows, recomputation, no added false accepts, and closed attacks.
field_principles.reported_vs_recomputed_deltas: Shows reported metrics equal row recomputation.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Content-addresses the artifact with volatile fields normalized.
field_principles.selective_vs_always_accuracy_delta: Bare matched accuracy delta for selective minus always.
field_principles.selective_vs_always_median_and_tail_cost: Shows median and tail cost savings or crossover cells.
field_principles.status: Names whether the verification-cost replay is complete, blocked, or null.
field_principles.tests_run: Records required test, coverage, spec, adversarial, and root-clutter checks.
field_principles.verification_cost_error_definition: Defines cost errors separately from exact correctness.
field_principles.verification_cost_error_rate_by_budget: Reports budgeted misses of exact-incorrect rows.
field_principles.verification_cost_study_ready_score: Bare readiness gate for downstream use.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Marks only deterministic event and certificate checks as oracles.

honest_verdict: complete: selective verification matched always-refine accuracy with lower median and tail cost

verification_cost_error_definition.abstention_handling: abstained rows are reported as abstentions and are not counted as exact-incorrect rows
verification_cost_error_definition.acceptance_authority: only deterministic exact event checks and independent CCG certificate checks
verification_cost_error_definition.cost_error_definition: incorrect row not identified by the arm within its declared checker-call and wall-time budget
